about_the_game:
Iris is lost, and this place doesn't make sense.

But she's sure she'll find her brother here. Call it a gut feeling.

Maybe you can help her uncover what's really occurring...

OVERVIEW

Iris Dissolution is a single-player survival horror game inspired by genre classics. Explore and fight your way out of increasingly surreal environments lurked by horrific creatures.

Featuring fixed camera angles, strategic inventory management, intricate puzzles and a retro visual style; the game delivers a nostalgic experience alongside a touching story of helpless grief.

STORY

Long hours down the road on her motorcycle led Iris to this desolate town. Looking for her younger brother, she`ll have to settle for any help she can get. After meeting a mysterious old man in a bar, she begins to realize this place is not what it seems. It is alive. With her time running out, she is still determined to find her brother, at any cost.

A WORLD OF DELIRIUM

Make your way through eerie, unpredictable locations. Scavenge the scarce resources in the environment, keep moving forward, and never let your guard down. Remember you are always being watched.

Your cellphone may be of use in here. Let's just hope there's service somewhere nearby.

RETRO VISUALS

The surreal landscapes of this haunting world come accompanied by PSX-style graphics, interesting character designs, and enchanting piano melodies, creating an unnervingly beautiful experience.

content_descriptors.notes: Display of weapons, violence against fantasy creatures, blood, themes about death and duel, profanity, swearing.
